weights_vs_directwrite.summary: Only weight 500 changed: it now resolves to the Regular face's FontId (0x8000000000000000, same as 400) with ink 298.6 instead of the synthesized-bold 473.9 (heavier than real Semibold 600 at 399.2). Its ink ratio against the browser-like DirectWrite render is now 1.16, the same as 400 (the remaining gap is the shared gamma/contrast difference, not weight). 300-450 and 550-900 are unchanged. DirectWrite's own GetFirstMatchingFont maps 500 to Semibold; the fix follows CSS/browsers as the ticket asks.

present_latency.method: real window 320x200, present hook draws LastDrawnScene through Renderer.DrawScene; notify from idle (60 ms gap) to the present hook's return; DwmFlush = the same window with its surface unregistered from the frame source
present_latency.note: notify->present measures from the notify to the present hook's DrawScene return (submission), from idle. The waitable path starts the first frame after idle immediately; the DwmFlush path first waits for the next composition. Continuous frames stay vblank paced (4.18 ms/frame at 239 Hz). Idle: 0 presents in 300 ms.

fixtures: No bit-exact fixture changed: textspec, glyphspec, scenespec, pathspec, fontspec and conformance pass unchanged. No fixture renders weight 500, so the intended weight-500 change has no fixture to update.
